leadGeneration.name: Sales Outreach Bot
leadGeneration.short: Find, enrich, and reach ideal customers.
leadGeneration.long: Our Lead Generation agent scrapes LinkedIn, enriches contacts, scores leads, and sends personalized outreach automatically.

seoContent.name: Content Generator
seoContent.short: Research keywords and publish SEO articles automatically.
seoContent.long: The Content agent analyzes competitors, finds keyword opportunities, generates high‑quality articles, and schedules publishing for organic traffic.

partnerships.name: Partnership Scout
partnerships.short: Discover and recruit affiliates and partners.
partnerships.long: Find potential partners, score fit, and automate outreach to build your affiliate network.

contractReview.name: Legal Review Bot
contractReview.short: Analyze contracts for risks and suggest improvements.
contractReview.long: Upload a contract and our AI flags risky clauses and recommends amendments.

regulatoryMonitoring.name: Compliance Watchdog
regulatoryMonitoring.long: Monitor regulatory updates, assess impact, and generate compliance documentation automatically.

accountsReceivable.name: Finance Assistant
accountsReceivable.short: Automate invoice follow‑ups and improve cash flow.
accountsReceivable.long: Sync invoices, send reminder sequences, and negotiate payment terms with AI.

spendAnalysis.name: Cost Optimizer
spendAnalysis.long: Categorize transactions, identify redundant subscriptions, and discover cheaper alternatives to cut costs.

dynamicPricing.name: Pricing Strategist
dynamicPricing.short: Optimize prices based on demand and competition.
dynamicPricing.long: Monitor competitor pricing, run A/B tests, and let AI find revenue‑maximizing price points.

dataScraper.short: Extract data from completely any website.
